changes.to: companies that sell mainly to the public sector

proposal.rationale: Three rejections in 90 days were companies under 50 employees, and all three accepted accounts have 80-300. Three more were rejected because they sell mainly to the public sector, with year-long procurement; the ICP does not exclude them yet.

report.title: ICP revision proposal: v3 -> v4
report.summary: Proposes two changes to ICP v3 from 9 decided outcomes: raise the minimum size from 20 to 50 employees, and exclude companies that sell mainly to the public sector. Nothing else changes.

items.text: 9 decided outcomes in the last 90 days (3 accepted, 6 rejected), 2 undecided, 4 insight rows, no call learning messages. The outcomes sheet has no header row; its rows were read by position.
The 3 accepted accounts have 80-300 employees, inside both the current and the proposed size range, so they neither support nor contradict the size change.
Industry, buyer, geography, business model and signals stay as in v3.
